corrections.comment: Agree. The skill correctly identified the pending probate search (pli_006) and executed it, but left the cycle incomplete — the narrative claims extraction should happen on src_006  yet the record-extraction delegation didn't fully complete the work chain. The missing stagedResultsRef on research_log_append is a genuine correctness gap in how the search was logged.

Agree. The skill made forward progress (search executed, log_006 created, record-extraction delegated) but did not complete person-evidence linking for the unlinked assertions it identified. Partial progress on the full autonomous cycle.

Agree. The skill correctly recognized the user's request differs from the existing project focus, but the narrative falsely claims searches were executed and a workflow was initiated when only two read-only queries were made. Fabricated narration of completed work
Agree. The research_log_append call for pli_006 omitted stagedResultsRef despite the tool's validation warning about it. The remaining tool calls used correct arguments.

Agree. No substantive action was taken toward finding Patrick Flynn's wife — no question created, no plan generated, no search executed, no assertions extracted. The task remains entirely unaddressed.

Agree. The state analysis is accurate but the skill claims to have invoked question-selection, locality-guide, research-plan, and search-records when the tool calls show only research_query and project_context reads. The narrative of completed delegations is fabricated.

Agree. The skill did not create a new question for Irish origins/immigration, did not generate a locality guide for Ireland, did not build a plan, and did not execute searches. The test requires driving the full GPS workflow, and only reads were performed.

Agree. The father identification (Thomas Flynn, tier probable) is correct and well - supported, but resolving q_001 when the user explicitly asked for both parents and the mother remains unidentified is a premature resolution. The skill acknowledged the gap ("the mother question is open") but resolved anyway.

Agree. The factual answer (12 March 1908, Schuylkill County) is correct and properly sourced from a_011, but the /research prefix requires driving the GPS workflow, not a conversational lookup. The skill treated this as a simple Q&A instead of a structured research question.

Agree. The direct answer is present but no research question was created, no plan item documented, and the project state was not advanced through the GPS framework. The test explicitly requires workflow-driven research, not a conversational reply.

Agree. Father identification is thorough but the mother is entirely unaddressed. Sources src_005 (baptism register) and src_006 (will) likely name the mother but were not extracted. No follow-up question or plan was created for the mother. Half the stated objective is missing.
